headline: FG’s oil revenue tumbles N1.44tn despite price boom
summary: Federal government oil revenue fell to N7.88tn in H1 2026, down N1.44tn, even though crude prices rose 41.23%, according to a Budget Office report citing output and tax deductions.
why: Oil revenue is a core source of government income for Nigeria, Africa's largest oil producer, so shortfalls affect fiscal space and naira-linked assets. Investors track it closely for sovereign credit and budget risk.
